build_commands: sh -c 'if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"'"'"type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"module"'"'"' package.json; then sed -i '"'"'s/"type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"module"/"type": "commonjs"/'"'"' package.json; echo '"'"'[build] package.json declared type=module; set to commonjs to match the CommonJS tsc emits'"'"'; fi; tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --allowJs $(find . -name '"'"'*.ts'"'"' -not -path '"'"'./node_modules/*'"'"' -not -name '"'"'*.d.ts'"'"' 2>/dev/null) ./subject.cts || tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck ./subject.cts'
